banned.claim: Calling the pizzas 'clean eating' or a 'clean' diet food as a headline claim.
banned.why: 'Clean' is vague and risky as a headline claim under FDA/FTC food guidance - use specific facts like 'no added sugar' instead.
'Natural' is undefined and risky for food claims - not supported by any labeling on the site.

banned.claim: Any 'boosts immunity' or 'detox' language around the food.
banned.why: Banned health claims for this category - unqualified immunity/detox claims are prohibited.

banned.claim: 'Low sugar' or 'high protein' unless it matches the actual Nutrition label.
banned.why: Nutrient-content claims must match the verified label; only 'no added sugar' is currently substantiated.

banned.claim: Suggesting the pizza helps with weight loss or 'burns fat'.
banned.why: Banned disease/body-composition claim for food and beverage.

banned.claim: Stating a fixed cook time as guaranteed regardless of dough (e.g. 'always 5 minutes').
banned.why: Site says time varies with dough thickness - avoid an unqualified absolute time claim.
